reason: Prevent partial distributed-shard collection from being mistaken for near-full-market coverage.
scope: TDX personal-research trade archive feature contract only; no return inference until shard-aware coverage gate is ready.

source.distributed_contract: canonical active TDX plan + scheduler policy + coordinator cluster assignments

valid_directional_record: side in {buy,sell} and price>0 and volume>0

features.small_order_threshold: within each symbol-day, 20th percentile of avg_lots_per_order_proxy
features.small_order_notional_share: notional proxy from records at/below the small-order threshold divided by all directional notional proxy
features.small_order_buy_imbalance: buy-sell notional imbalance inside the small-order proxy subset

coverage_gate.expected_symbols: per day and per shard, lifecycle-adjusted from the canonical scheduler policy
coverage_gate.qualified_day: trading day in frozen plan AND total feature_symbols >= min_symbols_per_day AND every shard actual feature symbols >= ceil(expected eligible symbols for that shard * 0.9) AND no unexpected feature symbol

missing_policy.directional_trade_but_no_positive_order_: BuyImbalance remains available; small-order fields remain null
missing_policy.neutral_or_status_side: excluded from directional metrics, retained in quality counts
missing_policy.nonpositive_volume: excluded from directional metrics, retained in quality counts
missing_policy.missing_one_or_more_shards: day is not qualified even if the total feature-symbol count exceeds the absolute minimum

inference_policy: require_inference_ready must pass the shard-aware 120-day gate before any return-predictive significance study is launched.
limitations: No claim that the small-order proxy identifies retail investors.
No claim that price*provider_lots is RMB turnover.
Lifecycle bounds are retrospective acquisition bounds and are not PIT universe evidence.
Shard completeness proves collection coverage relative to the frozen distributed plan, not vendor-history completeness.
Attention/search/forum data are not part of V2.
